title: subspace event file, version 1
description: One agent hook event as written to $ROOT/events/<UTC date>/<ts>-<pid>-<random>.json. See docs/contract.md §4. The payload is the source agent's hook JSON, unchanged; its format belongs to that agent and is only sketched here.

v.description: Format version. Apps skip files with an unknown version.

source.description: Agent that produced the event, e.g. "claude-code" or "codex" (contract §4). Apps ignore sources they don't know.

ts.description: Unix seconds when the plugin saw the event. With async hooks this is not the exact moment of the event.

pid.description: Parent process of the launched hook command. Its source-specific meaning is defined in contract §4.

payload.description: The hook's stdin JSON, byte for byte. Fields depend on source and hook_event_name; see docs/events/ and fixtures/<source>/<version>/.
